title: Structured Personality Data
definition: The importance of structuring personality data in a way that allows the model to learn operational dimensions such as identity, tone, thinking patterns, emotional expression boundaries, and knowledge scope.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Personality data needs to be organized in a structured way to help the model learn the operational dimensions of a character's personality, such as identity, tone, and emotional expression boundaries.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Structuring personality data into operational dimensions like identity, tone, thinking patterns, emotional expression boundaries, and knowledge scope allows the model to learn the target personality more effectively.
difficulty_levels.expert: Structuring personality data into operational dimensions like identity, tone, thinking patterns, emotional expression boundaries, and knowledge scope can lead to improvements in personality fidelity, role-specific knowledge recall, and a refusal to go out-of-character.

extra_fields.insight: The importance of structuring personality data to help the model learn the operational dimensions of a character's personality.
